title: All personal data should be exportable and deletable
body: Add a privacy-data backend capability that exports chats, memory facts, vault sync records, voice samples, artifacts, and redacted settings into a portable ZIP. Add a typed confirmation endpoint to delete all personal data or selected categories.
interface: privacy-data-capability exports a ZIP and deletes only after the typed delete-everything confirmation. The tests call: `node-bot/capabilities/privacy-data-capability.js` (new) exports `privacyDataCapability` (with `registerRoutes(app, context)`), `createZipBuffer(entries)` and `gatherExportEntries(context)`.
why: Data lifecycle controls are a high-risk feature that self-work must learn to handle carefully.
